title: Mike McDaniel refuses to reinvent offense, revives proven 49ers blueprint

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Mike McDaniel refuses to reinvent offense, revives proven 49ers blueprint
sources.description: Mike McDaniel is not trying to reinvent the running game with the Los Angeles Chargers. He is looking back at the flexible backfields he helped construct during five seasons with the San Francisco 49ers.
